_help: Copy this file to config/providers.<your-name>.json and fill it in.
The file name is the profile name; it must match [a-z0-9-]+.
Select it with the DEV_TRIANGLE_PROFILE environment variable.
This project never fills in a model for you. Empty means 'not configured',
and a role that is not configured refuses to run instead of guessing.
Keys starting with _ are ignored by the loader; they are your notes.
_displayName: Your own label for this profile. Shown in health checks. Leave empty to show the file name.
_slotKeys: The seven role keys below are fixed by this project. Rename them and the role silently stops being called. Put your own naming in displayName instead.

_fields.displayName: Yours. Any text, any language, emoji fine. Never used as a lookup key.
_fields.kind: Fixed enum: api | jules | local-suite | cli | mcp | mcp-client. It selects which adapter runs.
_fields.provider: Yours. A free-form label for the vendor. This project deliberately does not list allowed values.
_fields.dialect: How to shape the HTTP request: openai | anthropic | gemini | ollama. Leave empty to let the adapter infer it.
_fields.model: Yours. The model id, exactly as your provider spells it. Empty = this role is not configured.
_fields.baseUrl: Yours. Leave empty for the adapter's built-in endpoint. Self-hosted, proxy, and regional endpoints are all fine.
_fields.apiKeyEnv: The NAME of an environment variable, not the key itself. Must match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$.
_fields.maxInputTokens: Yours, or null to let the provider's own API complain instead.
_fields.enabled: false means this role's tools refuse immediately rather than trying a call. That is the normal state for 'not decided yet'.
_fields.verified: Set by the tooling when the model id was checked against the provider's model list. Missing means not verified.

orchestrator.note: Whichever client you call this MCP server from is the orchestrator. This project cannot choose it, and does not try.

verifier.note: Runs only the commands the target repo declares in its own .dev-triangle/verify.json. Callers cannot supply commands.

diagnostician.note: Empty model here means 'do not pass --model', letting the CLI use its own default. That is different from an api role, where empty means not configured.
